facts.statement: The researchers created a new fluorescent tool called DQ that only measures acidity when it is near specific clumps of amyloid protein.
facts.subject: other

facts.statement: The new tool was tested in cell cultures and in mice that carry genes linked to Alzheimer's disease to check how well it works.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The study found that the area around the protein plaques becomes more acidic as the disease gets worse and as the animals get older.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The increased acidity near the plaques was linked to problems with the waste-recycling compartments inside the damaged nerve fibers.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: The research showed that when these waste compartments break down, they leak acid into the surrounding tissue.
facts.subject: animals

facts.statement: Fixing the problems with the waste compartments reduced the amount of plaques, inflammation, and memory issues in the study subjects.
facts.subject: animals
